R1090.problem: Limit overlap to newest BIOS entry
R1090.evidence: Only newest BIOS entry adjoins returned hardware suffix. Without clearing boundary identity per iteration,multiple BIOS makes can share one release. P86/final only-newest-overlaps and untranslated-newest cases exercise this.

R1091.problem: Flush before a two-record pair overruns odd remaining space
R1091.evidence: Joining an existing release makes output length odd. Original i<0 permits i==0,then next pair writes index-1. R1094.evidence: Original loop writes key data at descending KeyInx but EventType at ascending KeyToRtn-1. If actual history shorter than requested,returned tail element may lack KEY_EVENT. Store EventType beside the key in the same slot. P90 original-return function control fails record/count contract.

R1095.problem: Return initialized suffix and actual count
R1095.evidence: Original KeyToRtn starts1 and increments after copied element,so completion value is copied count+1. Original writes array prefix even when initialized history occupies suffix. P90 whole-original ReturnUnusedKeyEvents compiles but duplicates records/fails. Current guard prevents empty/uninitialized prepend and writes KeyInx+1,KeyToRtn-1.
R1095.plan: Retain guard and exact initialized suffix pending owner;no extra allocation.

R1096.problem: Capture only successfully prepended first event
R1096.evidence: BIOS join requires actual successfully returned oldest event. Failed/zero-length writes must not create that boundary. Final BIOS cases cover failure,zero and matching release. Closing brace scopes the guarded prepend.
R1096.plan: Remove inline marker;retain successful-write capture and scope pending owner.

R1097.evidence: NTSRV resolves CONSOLE scope from authenticated frontend association;PARTICIPANT scope only closes worker. Original PostMessage targets local hWndConsole,not copied frontend group or embedded VM owner. Request Console exit then retire calling thread;independent lifecycle receiver invokes original cleanup at R1079 after permission.
R1097.plan: Remove5 explanatory comment lines;retain existing one-call request/ExitThread boundary pending owner. No timeout/retry or local teardown permission.

R1098.problem: Snapshot source identity before resetting controller
R1098.evidence: Original keys_in_6805_buff counts emitted key markers and resets hardware;counts cannot identify ignored releases or multi-byte origins. PendingKeyboardHistory selects live source identities before Reset6805and8042 clears ring. P86 original history control demonstrates wrong raw suffix. Associated replacement extern declares actual reset dependency.
R1098.plan: Retain snapshot and required reset declaration pending owner;inline marker removed.

R1099.problem: Keep original reset and return unique pending identities
R1099.evidence: Source selection must precede controller reset;reset remains original hardware reset function. Returned count is selected identity count plus original KeyQueue count,which is zero in this profile. Final origin fixture proves unread output once,consumed output not replayed,held/prefix dedup and post-reset cleanup.
R1099.plan: Retain original reset plus identity count pending owner;inline marker removed.
